what_to_detect: A creature with unleash and a +1/+1 counter is forbidden from blocking, the responsible static being the one unleash generates.
near_miss: A creature with unleash and no +1/+1 counter is listed among the legal blockers.
record_fields: blockers record forbidden[].responsible_static (provenance keys of the Unleash keyword line)
note: Without a keyword filter on the responsible static, legal_blockers outside with responsible_static tags every static 'can't block' (Pacifism-style Auras, defender-like statics) as this rule.
